nodes.name: .oxlintrc.json
nodes.summary: Oxlint configuration enabling the React, TypeScript, and Oxc plugins and enforcing rules-of-hooks plus the only-export-components rule.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent-facing contributor guide for the repository, documenting commands, the strict separation between src/game, src/audio, and src/state, project gotchas, hard rules, and graphify usage.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview describing the Dark Room-like music-as-combat browser game, its stack choices, pnpm scripts, the src/ layout, and the versioned localStorage save format.

nodes.name: components.json
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui configuration selecting the new-york style with the neutral base color, cssVariables, a lucide icon library, and the @/* import aliases used by generated components.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Vite HTML entry shell that provides the #root mount element and loads the React application via the /src/main.tsx module script.
nodes.languageNotes: Plain Vite index shell with a module script tag; no bundler-specific templating.

nodes.name: opencode.json
nodes.summary: OpenCode agent configuration enabling the lightpanda plugin and defining the coder, plan, and reviewer agents with their models, modes, system prompts, and step limits.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Project manifest declaring the ESM sound-angels package, its dev/build/lint/preview/test scripts, and runtime dependencies (React 19, Zustand, Tone.js, Tailwind/shadcn) with the Vite and Vitest toolchain.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler options for the browser app under src/, targeting ES2023 with bundler resolution, react-jsx, strict unused checks, erasable syntax only, and the @/* path alias for shadcn.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses verbatimModuleSyntax and erasableSyntaxOnly, which forbid enums, namespaces, and parameter properties in the app sources.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Solution-style TypeScript config with no files of its own that references the app and node project configs for `tsc -b` composite builds.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler options for the Node-side build tooling, compiling vite.config.ts with nodenext resolution and the same strict unused/erasable-syntax checks.
